name: Alert
usage: Reminders that a feature is not configured, secrets shown only once, notes in a danger zone

props.name: tone
props.description:
Meaning of the alert: `info` for neutral information, `success`, `warning` for limits and risks, `danger` for
errors.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Shows the icon of the tone before the text.

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows a close button; the alert disappears when it is clicked.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the close button is clicked.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Persistent information in an area that needs the user's attention; `tone` sets the meaning.
